checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: All 256 byte values, back-to-back frames, invalid stops and delayed recovery, reset throughout frames and recovery, randomized stream; 5851 cycles and 373 valid frames.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation was not accessed or run.
Output byte is checked only when done is asserted, as specified.
implementation_notes: Positive-edge synchronous active-high reset. Eight LSB-first data samples follow the start bit. A valid expected stop pulses done and publishes the byte. A missing stop discards the frame and waits for a high bit before seeking a new start.
